elements.requirement: Section 77A applies to an application made to the sheriff for an order under section 32A.
elements.quote: applies to an application to the sheriff for an order under section ... 32A

elements.requirement: Rules of court must make provision to ensure that an application to the sheriff for an order under section 32A is dealt with in private.
elements.quote: Rules of court must make provision for the purposes of ensuring that an application to which this section applies is dealt with in private

elements.requirement: Rules of court must specifically require the sheriff to determine an application for an order under section 32A in private.
elements.quote: require the sheriff to determine an application in private

elements.requirement: Rules of court must specifically secure that any hearing on an application for an order under section 32A is to be held in private.
elements.quote: secure that any hearing is to be held in private

elements.requirement: Rules of court must specifically ensure that notice of an application for an order under section 32A, or of any order being made, is not given to the person to whom the authorisation or notice that is the subject of the application or order relates.
elements.quote: ensure that notice of an application (or of any order being made) is not given to— (i) the person to whom the authorisation or notice which is the subject of the application or order relates

elements.requirement: Rules of court must specifically ensure that notice of an application for an order under section 32A, or of any order being made, is not given to the representatives of the person to whom the authorisation or notice relates.

The Court of Session's power under section 32 of the Sheriff Courts (Scotland) Act 1971 to regulate and prescribe the procedure and practice for an application to the sheriff for an order under section 32A is subject to, but is not otherwise constrained by, section 32B and section 77A.
elements.quote: is subject to, but is not otherwise constrained by, section 32B and this section
